title: Smartphone-based alerting system: Evaluation of the "Region of Lifesavers" system on the basis of the international "Reporting Standard"
summary:
Background: Sudden cardiac arrest is one of the leading causes of death in Germany. Only about 10% of patients with out-of-hospital cardiac arrest can be discharged from hospital. The main reason for this is a treatment-free interval in the first few minutes. If cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) is started within less than 5 minutes and ideally defibrillation is also performed before the arrival of the emergency services, the survival rate can be doubled to quadrupled. Since 2021, the international guidelines for resuscitation recommend the establishment of smart technologies to activate first responders who are in the immediate vicinity of the emergency scene in the event of emergency calls with suspected cardiac arrest. The Region of Lifesavers system includes a smartphone-based alerting app connected to the dispatch centre and a network of publicly accessible AED. The system was established in Freiburg in 2018 and is currently being set up in many districts in Germany.
Methodology: Retrospective observational study of the implemented system "Region der Lebensretter". The process and quality parameters of the individual missions are to be continuously evaluated in order to be able to check the functionality.
Questions: Are the process times (e.g. departing, arrival) adequate to guarantee a time advantage over the rescue service? How does the density of first responders relate to the response rate and process times? Is the distribution of AED locations adequate? Can the system be further improved conceptually or technologically?

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of process and quality parameters of the smartphone-based alerting system "Region of Lifesavers". The basis for evaluation parameters is the international reporting standard for first responder systems.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Operations with activation of the Region of Lifesavers system by the dispatch centre
Exclusion criteria:
False alarms (termination by the dispatch centre, accidental activation of the system), test alarms
